comments: Non-adopted value inferred from the stated +0.08 mag metallicity correction. The authors retain the uncorrected result because the sign and amplitude of the metallicity effect were considered uncertain.
Non-adopted ALLFRAME value inferred by adding the stated +0.08 mag metallicity correction. It remains affected by the chip-dependent aperture-correction discrepancy.
Theoretical pulsation-model correction interpolated between Z=0.008 and 0.02. For mu_LMC=18.50+/-0.10, equation (5) gives D=7.3+/-0.6 Mpc, close to the maser distance.
Empirical metallicity correction. For mu_LMC=18.50+/-0.10, equation (4) gives D=7.9+/-0.6 Mpc. e_R is the relative-modulus error; e_T includes the LMC zero-point uncertainty.
Data from Macri et al. 2006, apply metallicity correction but it is not clear how they do it.

Preferred result from metallicity interpolation of the restricted inner-plus-outer HST sample. The random term includes fitting, RV, and metallicity-scale contributions; it agrees with the maser distance.
